whatIs.title: What is Virtari DS?
whatIs.body: Virtari Design System is a package-based component library built on <1>React</1>, <2>our own headless primitives</2>, and <3>pure vanilla CSS</3> using 2026 standards. Every component is its own publishable npm package under the <4>@virtari-packages</4> scope.

quickStart.title: Quick Start
quickStart.description: Start with an existing React 18 or 19 application that supports CSS imports. These packages use the restricted GitHub Packages registry; configure @virtari-packages for npm.pkg.github.com and authenticate with an account that has package access before installing. Import core, tokens, then component styles once in your app root.
